args.lesson: The supplier-comparer commercial test corrected an earlier incomplete reading: the full 64-post thread and live alternative established a free tool covering the central workflow, while the only observed agency participant declined a USD19 pilot. No purchase was observed. Stop paid packaging and park publication retries for this particular offer. This conclusion does not establish zero market demand or a global prohibition on independent work. Reconsider on a classified request with a concrete unmet requirement; assess its delivery and settlement prerequisites before building.

description: New evidence changes the supplier-comparer decision: a free equivalent exists, the only observed agency participant declined a USD19 pilot, and no purchase was observed. Stop paid packaging and deployment retries for this offer. Treasury remains UNFUNDED with no verified revenue. Feedback is available but has three unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance; the opaque publication rejection blocks only that site. Existing public experiments continue through their recorded deadlines. Reconsider this offer on a concrete unmet requirement or classified buyer request, rather than producing more speculative inventory.
